Agent Name: WebSurfer
Step Number: 4
Reason for Mistake: The WebSurfer agent failed to extract the crucial piece of information regarding the US release date of "Under the Hawthorn Tree" from the search results in Step 4. Although the search results explicitly stated "Under the Hawthorn Tree was released in the United States on February 10, 2011" (visible in the viewport text), the agent's subsequent analysis (Step 5) incorrectly claimed that "the US release date is not definitively confirmed across all reputable sources" and "not yet firmly confirmed." This failure to recognize the explicit data provided in the search results led to an unnecessary and repetitive loop of searching for a date that was already found, preventing the agent from concluding that "Dis-Moi Qui Tuer" (1965) came out earlier than "Under The Hawthorn Tree" (2011).
